response.sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as num_races FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(num_races) as total_races, COUNT(*) as total_circuits FROM race_counts), circuit_stats AS (SELECT rc.circuitId, rc.num_races, rc.num_races * 1.0 / t.total_races as share, (rc.num_races * 1.0 / t.total_races) - (1.0 / t.total_circuits) as margin_above_average FROM race_counts rc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT circuitId, num_races, share, margin_above_average FROM circuit_stats WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
